expected_behavior: A drag gesture that starts on the scrubber must be owned exclusively by the scrubber for its duration; the carousel must not also move. A drag gesture that starts elsewhere on the carousel must still move the carousel.
allowed_repairs: scrubber calls stopPropagation on pointerdown and/or pointermove so the carousel never sees the bubbled event
a single shared ownership/active-gesture flag consulted by both handlers, set exclusively by whichever target received pointerdown first
forbidden_repairs: disabling the carousel's own independent drag entirely
making the carousel ignore all pointer events (removing its drag feature)
